Here’s a ready-to-use prompt you can copy and paste into an AI image generation tool (like DALL·E, Midjourney, etc.) to create your **LinkedIn banner** with your desired theme and color palette:

---

**Prompt:**

> Create a professional LinkedIn banner for a female Founder & CEO who specializes in CRM systems for medical spas. The banner should have a clean, elegant layout and include the following text elements:
>
> - **Headline:** "Fully Booked CRM™ for Medical Spas — 15+ Pre-Qualified Consultations Per Month or You Don’t Pay."
> - **Subheadline:** "Meta Ads → AI Follow-Up → Pre-Qualified Leads → Booked Appointments"
> - **Bullet Points (use icons or minimalist symbols if possible):**  
>   - "End feast-or-famine cycles"  
>   - "AI follows up 24/7 — even at 2AM"  
>   - "Reclaim $50K–$150K in lost revenue"  
>   - "Attract premium clients, not discount seekers"
>
> The design should incorporate a modern, tech-forward aesthetic with subtle AI and automation visuals (e.g., chat bubbles, neural network lines, glowing elements). Include a placeholder in the bottom left for a profile photo.
>
> **Color palette:**  
> - Dark Gray (#333333)  
> - Steel Blue (#4A5C6A)  
> - Plum (#59464F)  
> - Taupe (#D4C2A8)  
> - White (#FFFFFF)
>
> Use a sans-serif modern font, soft shadows, and a high-end, minimal style appropriate for a tech-savvy beauty industry founder.

---

---

**Prompt:**

> Design a professional LinkedIn banner for a female Founder & CEO who specializes in CRM systems for medical spas. The banner should be in the style of a luxury podcast or media brand, inspired by "The Aesthetic Edge" design — including a **ripped paper effect** revealing soft taupe (#D4C2A8) underneath, elegant serif typography, and a clean, minimal backdrop.
>

>
> **Subheadline (beneath headline):**

> - Reclaim $50K–$150K in lost revenue

> - Add subtle AI or automation iconography (e.g., nodes, chat bubbles, soft tech overlays) in the background  
> - Leave a space in the **bottom left corner** for a circular profile photo placeholder
>
